description: Community device reports for the leaderboard on benchmarks.html: one record per issue labelled device-report, keyed by the issue number. Generated from the issues by .github/workflows/ingest-reports.yml (tools/ingest/ingest.py); edit the issue, not this file.

fields.fps: Game fps, the frames the game itself renders, as reported. From the tools/bench row when the report has one, else parsed from the report's Results.
fields.p50_ms, p99_ms: Median and 99th percentile frame time in ms, or null when not reported.
fields.baseline: The figure the report compares with (for example the build without a switch), or null.
fields.scene_ok: true only when the numbers come from a tools/bench row that is valid and passed its scene check against the tester's reference screenshot; null otherwise.
fields.gpu_vendor, gpu_type: intel, amd, nvidia, qualcomm or other; integrated, discrete or unknown, from the form's Graphics card answer.
fields.device_class: The engine's GPU family for the reporter's GPU (src/common/device_profile.cpp; tools/ingest/device_classes.py): family, status (family, none when the GPU is in no family, unresolved when only the Graphics card answer names it), the candidates when unresolved, and the GPU name and where it was read. Only an exact GPU name or PCI ID gives a family.
fields.title_id: The game's program id: the tools/bench row's, else the listed game's (AGENTS.md); null when not known.
fields.runs: Every valid tools/bench row of the report: variant, scene, fps, p50_ms, p99_ms, the switches and settings it set, measured (UTC), machine_id, build (the emulator's own), power (ac or battery), quiet (tools/bench measured the other programs' CPU use, under its limit), within_2ms_pct and shown_fps where measured, and its warnings.
fields.notes: Caveats a reader should see next to the numbers.
fields.credit: The reporter's GitHub handle when they filled in "Credit me as" with the account that opened the report; null otherwise. It is the only personal detail a record carries, and only by consent.
fields.records: The Records board: per GPU class (the form's Graphics card answer) and scene, the best row that is valid with scene_ok true, by game fps, then lower p99, then the earlier report. credit is null when the reporter did not ask for one.

282.power_mode: High performance, power mode Best performance, plugged in
282.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
282.scene: Opening Scene/Menu, full screen on handheld mode.
282.settings: Guarana launcher 0.1.0, mode custom, profile desktop-dgpu. The launcher does not know about settings changed by hand or EDEN_NX2_* switches set elsewhere: add them here, or write none.
